Processes.Name: Test - Companion serialisation harvest
Processes.Description: Test Process for the frends-companion plugin: harvests the export encoding of the MCP Trigger, the RabbitMQ Trigger with client certificate authentication and the Inclusive Decision. Placeholder values only. Not for use; never activate.
